title: Google rolls out Project Genie updates to AI Ultra subscribers, including Genie 4, new Genie 3 features, an agent to build worlds, and a gallery to share them (Google)
summary: Google: Google rolls out Project Genie updates to AI Ultra subscribers, including Genie 4, new Genie 3 features, an agent to build worlds, and a gallery to share them — Explore a new Project Genie experience for Google AI Ultra subscribers, featuring Genie 4, the Project Genie agent, and a community gallery.
